## P01 Start from the reason the work must exist

- **MHJ-CL-002** (directly stated, high): She begins from the purpose of the work (why this project must exist, what gap it fills) rather than from a spread of references, and treats ideation from an aimless reference pile as a failure mode.
  - Sources: MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; 뉴시스, 2024-02; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; OSEN, 2013-09; fol:in YouTube, 2025-01, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-003** (directly stated, high): The intended purpose is the one non-negotiable in production: when execution damages the original intent she returns to the start rather than accepting a drifted result.
  - Sources: GQ Korea, 2015-09; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; OSEN, 2013-09; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-137** (directly stated, high): She starts a venture from a felt gap in the current scene, what is missing that people sense without naming, and expects consumers to recognise a real alternative, rather than from a reading of what is already succeeding.
  - Sources: 일간스포츠, 2023-09; 엑스포츠뉴스, 2025-12, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context

## P02 Treat the brief's category words as questions

- **MHJ-CL-005** (directly stated, high): Before designing, she interrogates the category word or stock phrase in the brief (what kind of 'girl', what a 'dream girl' actually is, what a group name could mean) and reinterprets it until it carries a specific idea; clichés in the brief are treated as questions.
  - Sources: OSEN, 2013-09; 연합뉴스, 2013-02; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; 오마이뉴스, 2013-03
- **MHJ-CL-139** (directly stated, medium): She warns against reverse-engineering success from outcomes or reading something new through old frames, and questions whether 'public appeal' is itself an assumption learned by repetition; she distinguishes real newness from inertia wearing the mask of newness.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; 뉴시스, 2024-02; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03
- **MHJ-CL-140** (directly stated, high): She interrogates the industry's vocabulary, such as 'industry', 'system', 'professional manager', 'idol' as a job title or 'puppet', arguing that impressive-sounding words can hide that culture is made by people and moves people.
  - Sources: 중앙일보, 2024-09, dispute context; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02
- **MHJ-CL-073** (directly stated, high): She avoids words that announce a benefit or impose a frame — 'healing', 'comfort', 'worldview', 'idol' as a job title — because naming the effect makes it condescending or fixed; she later revised her rejection of 'repaying fans with good work'.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context

## P03 Find the meaning the project already owns

- **MHJ-CL-006** (reasonable inference, high): She locates meaning in something the project already owns (its name, initials, the organisation's core activity) and re-reads it, rather than importing an external theme.
  - Sources: 연합뉴스, 2018-07; YouTube (Big Hit / HYBE official channel, 2021-03; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-007** (directly stated, high): She returns a familiar object or form to its archetype before styling or designing it: asking what the original form of something is (a school uniform, basic shapes and primary colours, a song stripped of burdensome elements) and building from that basis.
  - Sources: NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; 월간 디자인 (Design+) 417호, 2013-03; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-046** (directly stated, high): She builds the concept on the subject's actual, often under-shown traits - drawn from everyday conversation with them - rather than imposing a type, and treats an artist's unseen plain side as material.
  - Sources: 마이데일리, 2013-02; OSEN, 2013-09; 뉴시스, 2023-08; SPOTV NEWS, 2023-09; W Korea, 2014-08; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02

## P04 Size the audience by who does not yet care

- **MHJ-CL-092** (directly stated, high): She sizes the audience by who does not yet care about the category: existing fans will look anyway, so the gain lies in drawing outsiders across gender, generation and genre, and many supporters report never having liked the category before.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; W Korea, 2014-08; 월간 디자인 (Design+) 417호, 2013-03; 아주경제 / NNA, 2026-07, dispute context; 일간스포츠, 2023-09
- **MHJ-CL-093** (directly stated, high): She designs for a specific, true emotion or durable instinct rather than for a demographic, market or trend, expecting well-made points of empathy to travel and things liked across eras to stay good; she explicitly denies targeting retro.
  - Sources: 일간스포츠, 2023-09; 뉴스엔, 2024-01; 아주경제 / NNA, 2026-07, dispute context; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; SBS 뉴스, 2022-09 …
- **MHJ-CL-098** (directly stated, high): She trusts audiences to recognise a real alternative and works from the self-as-first-customer test — what she would want as a member of the public — to locate a felt-but-unnamed gap, rather than from explicit market analysis.
  - Sources: 일간스포츠, 2023-09; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; 뉴시스, 2024-02; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; SBS 뉴스, 2022-09
- **MHJ-CL-099** (directly stated, medium): She questions what 'the public wants' as a learned assumption: people profess to want newness while seeking stability, cannot like only one direction, and have had 'public appeal' repeated into them — so supply and acceptance of change must develop together.
  - Sources: Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; 일간스포츠, 2023-09; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03

## P05 Position against the context; test newness for a reason

- **MHJ-CL-137** (directly stated, high): She starts a venture from a felt gap in the current scene, what is missing that people sense without naming, and expects consumers to recognise a real alternative, rather than from a reading of what is already succeeding.
  - Sources: 일간스포츠, 2023-09; 엑스포츠뉴스, 2025-12, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-027** (directly stated, high): She positions novelty relative to the surrounding context: she first identifies the established house style or the visual environment the work will appear in, then designs against it (the opposite of the existing company style, a deliberately plain billboard among glossy ones, an unexpected song in a huge venue).
  - Sources: BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; W Korea, 2014-08; デバク (daebak.tokyo), 2024-07, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-089** (directly stated, high): She stands out by contrast with the surrounding context rather than by escalating polish: positioning against the house style at SM, a deliberately plain billboard among glossy ones, a corporate briefing made entertaining, and a company announced with hand drawings instead of a release.
  - Sources: BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; 스타뉴스, 2025-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-026** (directly stated, high): She uses herself as the first customer - asking what she would want to experience, own or find fun as a member of the public - and assumes that what she genuinely likes others will like once they meet it, while checking that self-satisfaction does not slide into self-indulgence.
  - Sources: MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 마이데일리, 2016-11; GQ Korea, 2022-12; SBS 뉴스, 2022-09; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02
- **MHJ-CL-028** (directly stated, high): She tests proposed newness for disguised inertia: novelty must have a reason, a surface swap (a different shirt colour) is not change, and when an audience is bored the frame has to change, not the decoration.
  - Sources: BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-068** (directly stated, high): She positions new work against the established house style on purpose, treating novelty as relational, but tests each 'new' move for its reason because newness for its own sake is inertia in disguise.
  - Sources: BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; W Korea, 2014-08; GQ Korea, 2015-09; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; 마이데일리, 2013-02

## P06 The concept is the whole experience

- **MHJ-CL-011** (directly stated, high): She treats a concept as the felt whole across music, image, styling, release sequence and behaviour, and rejects equating concept with the visual layer; coherence among all touchpoints is what she designs for.
  - Sources: Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 월간 디자인 (Design+) 417호, 2013-03; OSEN, 2013-09
- **MHJ-CL-069** (directly stated, high): She treats the visual as downstream of and fused with the operating system: music, concept, marketing and business must move as one organism, which is why she sought roles combining producer and manager and why branding confined to graphics did not satisfy her.
  - Sources: 뉴시스, 2024-02; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; W Korea, 2021-04; 월간 디자인 (Design+) 417호, 2013-03
- **MHJ-CL-074** (directly stated, high): She designs how work is presented at the same time as the work itself, treating promotion as an action that makes people experience something; launch mechanics are part of the concept, not a later marketing step.
  - Sources: NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2026-02, dispute context

## P07 Derive the idea from the material's first impression

- **MHJ-CL-001** (directly stated, high): She derives a concept from the first image or scene the music itself evokes on hearing it, and only then reaches for outside references; the song, lyric or beat is the starting material, not a reference board.
  - Sources: 중앙일보, 2011-12; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; OSEN, 2013-09; 쿠키뉴스, 2014-08; 중앙일보, 2014-07; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context …
- **MHJ-CL-039** (directly stated, high): She treats sound as a primary design material: visual work aims to maximise the synaesthetic imagery of the music so people 'hear' it with their eyes, trailers and shoots are built around a song's mood, and the music played on set or in a space is chosen deliberately.
  - Sources: 중앙일보, 2014-07; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context; GQ Korea, 2015-09; W Korea, 2014-08 …
- **MHJ-CL-004** (directly stated, high): She works as a storyteller with a standing bank of imagined scenarios and group images, and when material arrives she selects the stored idea that would be most interesting to tell with it.
  - Sources: 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; OSEN, 2013-09; GQ Korea, 2022-12

## P08 Translate the impression; never copy the surface

- **MHJ-CL-030** (directly stated, high): She transforms references by translating the impression or feeling they give into a different medium (sound into image, image into an action or promotion) and explicitly does not copy what she loves within its own medium.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; GQ Korea, 2015-09; W Korea, 2014-08; 중앙일보, 2011-12
- **MHJ-CL-031** (directly stated, medium): When she borrows from a reference she takes its underlying energy, balance or structure (how still images sit with music, the singular energy a singer gave off) and judges originality at the level of the whole combination, while treating shared surface elements as free to use.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; GQ Korea, 2015-09; W Korea, 2014-08; CBS 라디오 FM 98.1 김현정의 뉴스쇼, 2024-04, dispute context; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-032** (directly stated, high): She treats references as a source of sensibility rather than style: within every genre she picks what matches one consistent sensibility, so the selection becomes a category of its own and goodness is not reduced to any one style or genre.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 조용한 생활 YouTube, 2026-08, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02
- **MHJ-CL-033** (directly stated, high): She deliberately draws her reference world from outside the category she works in (film, world and European music, older Korean records, art books) and treats the distance between that world and a mass format as the productive position.
  - Sources: 연합뉴스, 2018-07; OSEN, 2013-09; W Korea, 2014-08; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 중앙일보, 2024-09, dispute context; 뉴시스, 2024-09, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-035** (directly stated, high): She sources from the minor and finishes to a major standard: things others have not done, or overlooked subculture, are raised to mainstream finish and introduced in the most visible place, often with collaborators chosen from outside the establishment.
  - Sources: 경향신문 (via Nate 뉴스), 2026-05, dispute context; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; 한국일보, 2013-02; 마이데일리, 2013-02; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context

## P09 Build from a deliberate mismatch; set the emotional target precisely

- **MHJ-CL-014** (directly stated, high): She builds from deliberate mismatch: unexpected pairings (mainstream group with underground photographer, idol in a real alley, a pretty face with unaffected manner, opposite codes in one frame) are chosen because the meeting of unlike things carries more feeling than a consistent mood.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; OSEN, 2013-09; W Korea, 2014-08; GQ Korea, 2015-09; 뉴스엔, 2026-09, dispute context; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09 …
- **MHJ-CL-015** (directly stated, high): She sets the emotional target as a balance of opposites rather than one mood: brightness with melancholy, beauty that stays dry rather than cloying, warmth without syrup, a cheerful surface over a sadder inside.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; Hypebeast Korea, 2023-09; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07
- **MHJ-CL-050** (directly stated, medium): She grounds fantasy in real, ordinary settings and strips performed expression from subjects, so images read as outside a particular time and place and the unreal sits inside the real.
  - Sources: 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09

## P10 Coherence from a consistent reason, not lore

- **MHJ-CL-012** (directly stated, high): She builds coherence from a consistent reason or message expressed differently each time, not from constructed lore or a fixed visual form; she is openly averse to 'worldview' systems and prefers open premises that leave later developments free.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; W Korea, 2014-08; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; 오마이뉴스, 2013-03
- **MHJ-CL-013** (directly stated, high): She treats each release as a chapter in an arc rather than a reset: later releases answer or mirror earlier ones (a growth report, a return gift, a lock-and-key pair) and the structural principle itself can alternate between releases.
  - Sources: 오마이뉴스, 2013-03; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; Hypebeast Korea, 2023-09; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; Real Sound, 2023-08; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context …
- **MHJ-CL-029** (directly stated, medium): She keeps a stable core principle for a group while varying its surface each release, changing register without abandoning the core quality (for example a stronger look that keeps innocence and refuses the exposure-equals-sexy shortcut).
  - Sources: 스타뉴스, 2010-03; 중앙일보, 2011-12; 스포츠동아, 2011-10; 이데일리, 2011-11
- **MHJ-CL-067** (directly stated, high): She prefers brand systems with deliberate slack: each application may vary as long as it has sufficient reason, and a stable base principle (e.g. a group's core character) lets each release change its surface freely.
  - Sources: W Korea, 2014-08; 중앙일보, 2011-12; 이데일리, 2011-11; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context

## P11 Aim at the durable feeling; period looks are means, not briefs

- **MHJ-CL-022** (directly stated, high): She rejects trend-chasing: a trend is what the public copies after someone does something that fits and convinces, so trying to get ahead of trends is the posture of a late follower; trend fragments may enter as details, never as the direction.
  - Sources: 오마이뉴스, 2013-03; 경향신문 (via Nate 뉴스), 2026-05, dispute context; 뉴시스, 2024-02; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; Kstyle, 2024-12, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-023** (directly stated, high): She explicitly rejects retro or any period look as a target: what people are drawn to is universal and only the means of expression change, so she aims at something timeless (likened to a childhood treasure box) and lets period resonance appear only as a by-product or a small element of fun.
  - Sources: NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; SBS 뉴스, 2022-09; 뉴스엔, 2024-01; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context; CBS 라디오 FM 98.1 김현정의 뉴스쇼, 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-024** (reasonable inference, high): She uses period references to express a property of the present material (the movement of a dance, the image a song gives, the era of a covered song) and then holds them to the standard of people who know that period, rather than adopting a period as the theme.
  - Sources: 마이데일리, 2015-11; 중앙일보, 2011-12; 디스패치, 2012-08; Kstyle, 2024-12, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-141** (directly stated, high): She holds that chasing an existing hit or trend makes one a late follower, second or third at best, because by the time a trend hardens popular culture moves on; trend is what the public copies after someone does something that fits, not a target.
  - Sources: 오마이뉴스, 2013-03; 경향신문 (via Nate 뉴스), 2026-05, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2024-09, dispute context; South China Morning Post, unknown, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-143** (directly stated, high): She describes trends as cyclical while what people are instinctively drawn to stays constant, so she aims at durable, universal feelings and treats period resonance as a by-product, explicitly denying that retro is her target.
  - Sources: SBS 뉴스, 2022-09; 뉴스엔, 2024-01; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 경북도민일보 (News1 syndication), 2023-01; 오마이뉴스, 2013-03

## P12 Subtract toward the essential; quality lives in execution

- **MHJ-CL-016** (directly stated, high): She edits by subtraction: the longer she designs the more she removes, aiming for the essential element or the single self-sufficient image, deleting predictable or burdensome parts and decoration that serves no use.
  - Sources: W Korea, 2014-08; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 뉴시스, 2024-02; YouTube (Big Hit / HYBE official channel, 2021-03; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 마이데일리, 2015-11
- **MHJ-CL-020** (directly stated, high): She locates quality in the density of execution rather than in the choice of form or the size of the budget: the same form can be cheap or refined depending on how densely it is made, and basic elements applied well decide a low-budget result.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; 마이데일리, 2016-11

## P13 Intuitive is encoded, not literal

- **MHJ-CL-008** (directly stated, high): She separates intuitive work from literal work: delivering a childish thing childishly is not intuition; intuitive work is encoded with concept and thought yet can be decoded by the audience instantly and universally, and that is the target.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; W Korea, 2021-04; GQ Korea, 2015-09; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; 마이데일리, 2013-02; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-009** (directly stated, high): She deliberately calibrates how accessible a work is, moving between friendliness and unfriendliness and stopping before the public finds it too hard, on the view that easy work tires quickly and uniformity is the larger risk.
  - Sources: 중앙일보, 2014-07; OSEN, 2013-09; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; 경향신문 (via Nate 뉴스), 2026-05, dispute context; 엑스포츠뉴스 (via Daum), 2023-07
- **MHJ-CL-010** (directly stated, high): She keeps meanings open: she explains only the outline of her symbols, designs single symbols and names to hold two readings at once, and treats divergent readings as the viewer's right and as a way to set imagination working.
  - Sources: GQ Korea, 2015-09; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-061** (reasonable inference, medium): Her stated target for audience effort moved over time: in the SM years she embraced work that is 'slightly unfriendly' and makes people think, while in the ADOR years she stressed removing burdensome elements and work that is decoded effortlessly; the refusal of sameness stayed constant.
  - Sources: 중앙일보, 2014-07; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 뉴시스, 2024-02

## P14 Every visible element carries meaning

- **MHJ-CL-019** (directly stated, high): She treats every visible element as carrying meaning and holds the small detail to the same standard as the whole: staged objects in a jacket frame, one signature change per member, the period-accurate shoe at the last minute, light samples tested for a building.
  - Sources: 마이데일리, 2013-02; 스타뉴스, 2010-03; Kstyle, 2024-12, dispute context; W Korea, 2021-04; CBS 라디오 FM 98.1 김현정의 뉴스쇼, 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-021** (directly stated, high): She names atmosphere's basic carriers - light, sound and smell - as what decides a space or a film, and checks them physically rather than leaving them to defaults.
  - Sources: omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; W Korea, 2021-04; YouTube (Big Hit / HYBE official channel, 2021-03; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-066** (directly stated, high): Branding is treated as continuous curation in which every small choice signals, intended or not, so she reviews details down to materials and frame elements and holds that a brand must be maintained and repaired after launch rather than finished at a logo or building.
  - Sources: W Korea, 2021-04; YouTube (Big Hit / HYBE official channel, 2021-03; 마이데일리, 2013-02; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context

## P16 List the category's reflexes, then decide each one

- **MHJ-CL-041** (directly stated, high): She names a category's automatic conventions explicitly and designs their absence: obligatory high notes, inserted raps, uniform vocal delivery, knife-sharp synchronised dance, teasers as ritual, random collectibles, and the obvious styling shortcut.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; 엑스포츠뉴스 (via Daum), 2023-07; 스타뉴스, 2010-03 …
- **MHJ-CL-138** (directly stated, high): She rejects asserted 'success formulas': once a hit formula appears the industry repeats it until styles converge, and if such formulas worked everyone would succeed; she treats breaking the formula, including customary steps such as routine teasers, as part of the brief.
  - Sources: 뉴스엔, 2024-01; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context

## P17 Identity rigidity matches the brand's rate of change

- **MHJ-CL-053** (directly stated, high): She matches the rigidity of an identity system to how often the brand must change register: a fixed logo only where it does real work (making a premise credible), otherwise flexible marks built to transform, extend and be varied per release.
  - Sources: 월간 디자인 (Design+) 417호, 2013-03; W Korea, 2014-08; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; YouTube (Big Hit / HYBE official channel, 2021-03; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2024-09, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-063** (directly stated, high): A fixed symbol is introduced only where it does structural work — making an implausible premise credible, or unifying a group that has no logo — and is then varied in application rather than repeated identically, so the story it carries can grow.
  - Sources: W Korea, 2014-08; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; 월간 디자인 (Design+) 417호, 2013-03; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-064** (directly stated, high): Marks and names are chosen so one form carries several readings at once (letters, an animal, a heart; an acronym that is also a plain word), leaving viewers to find meanings rather than being told a single one.
  - Sources: NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context; Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context; MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2025-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-010** (directly stated, high): She keeps meanings open: she explains only the outline of her symbols, designs single symbols and names to hold two readings at once, and treats divergent readings as the viewer's right and as a way to set imagination working.
  - Sources: GQ Korea, 2015-09; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context

## P18 Never declare quality or benefit; name intuitively

- **MHJ-CL-060** (directly stated, high): She prefers sincerity to performed effect: she will not announce the benefit of a work (healing, comfort) or decorate subjects to look impressive, but makes the experience good and lets the benefit be received.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; 뉴스엔, 2024-01; Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-096** (directly stated, high): She refuses to impose a benefit on the audience: comfort is received voluntarily rather than handed down, rest cannot be compelled by designed 'fun', and culture improves through delicate tuning rather than proclamation — so she designs for a discerning user and lets the benefit follow.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; W Korea, 2021-04; GQ Korea, 2015-09
- **MHJ-CL-102** (directly stated, high): She holds that quality must never be declared: work loses value the moment it proclaims itself, those who know the value do not announce it, and she declines to explain an act's identity or a metaphor's meaning in advance.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; GQ Korea, 2015-09; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-144** (directly stated, medium): She argues that quality in popular culture rises through quiet tuning rather than proclamation: announcing that one has brought something good provokes resistance, so she avoids decoration or exaggeration and lets audiences notice quality and growth themselves.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-071** (directly stated, high): Her naming rule is intuitive over explanatory: short names with a good sound that land at once, slightly playful rather than serious, sometimes taken from the physical thing and its purpose.
  - Sources: MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context; W Korea, 2021-04; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04
- **MHJ-CL-072** (directly stated, high): Words can carry a deliberate double reading to set imagination working — a name pronounced as a plain word while its letters hold other meanings, or a slogan that is both a statement and a question.
  - Sources: Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context; MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2025-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-073** (directly stated, high): She avoids words that announce a benefit or impose a frame — 'healing', 'comfort', 'worldview', 'idol' as a job title — because naming the effect makes it condescending or fixed; she later revised her rejection of 'repaying fans with good work'.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context

## P19 The object performs the idea

- **MHJ-CL-055** (directly stated, high): She treats the physical album as a distinct object in the digital era: the cover's job is symbolic, functional needs such as portraits go inside, and the object should give holding, looking and listening at once.
  - Sources: 연합뉴스, 2018-07; 매일경제, 2012-04; MBC, 2011-10; GQ Korea, 2015-09; W Korea, 2014-08; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context …
- **MHJ-CL-056** (directly stated, high): She makes the product's real-world use into the concept so the object performs the idea: an album defined as a gift to be given on, a winter release packaged like a present, a phone's meaning built into a phone commercial, a fan object customisable by each owner.
  - Sources: OSEN, 2013-09; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; Hypebeast Korea, 2023-09; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02
- **MHJ-CL-111** (directly stated, high): Where a product's real-world use can become its meaning, she makes it so: an album defined as a gift to be given, a music video shot on the partner's phone so filming carries the message, and choreography built around phone filming.
  - Sources: OSEN, 2013-09; Hypebeast Korea, 2023-09; Real Sound, 2023-08
- **MHJ-CL-042** (directly stated, medium): She lets form follow the material rather than a platform rule: song length follows the song's development with predictable parts cut, the video format is matched to the track that can carry it, and each asset type is given its own job instead of all chasing one metric.
  - Sources: 뉴시스, 2024-02; Hypebeast Korea, 2023-09; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-088** (directly stated, high): She assigns each asset its own job instead of making every asset chase the same metric: dance videos show choreography, official videos carry larger meaning, b-side footage gives fans intimacy, and a cover carries a symbolic role while portraits sit inside the package.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; Hypebeast Korea, 2023-09

## P20 Stated stance: earn through quality and keepsakes, not inflation tactics

- **MHJ-CL-095** (directly stated, high): Her answer to the discomfort of earning from people who like the work is density of quality — give so many good things that even a blind pick never disappoints — expecting a voluntary virtuous cycle rather than extraction.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-107** (directly stated, high): She makes goods as keepsakes tied to a moment and as gifts rather than as standalone revenue lines, choosing simple, practical items that let the owner's own character show.
  - Sources: MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; OSEN, 2013-09; 이데일리, 2024-09, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-135** (directly stated, high): She states that money follows good work rather than leading it: she starts from what she herself would want as a customer, refuses to sell what she would not want, and answers the discomfort of earning from fans with a density of quality so that no purchase feels wasted.
  - Sources: 엑스포츠뉴스, 2025-12, dispute context; MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-084** (directly stated, medium): She removes growth tactics that inflate metrics — random photocards, paid video promotion, push-out sales — so that demand reflects genuine response, arguing that an uninflated signal shows reality more accurately and permits bolder next steps.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-136** (directly stated, high): She criticises industry practices that make numbers unreadable, such as push-out sales, lucky-draw purchases and talk of success unsupported by real figures, and judges a business by retained profit and real demand rather than top-line revenue or hype.
  - Sources: SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context

## P21 Every reveal has a reason for its moment, order and medium

- **MHJ-CL-074** (directly stated, high): She designs how work is presented at the same time as the work itself, treating promotion as an action that makes people experience something; launch mechanics are part of the concept, not a later marketing step.
  - Sources: NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2026-02, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-075** (directly stated, high): Every reveal is given a reason for its moment and position: teaser order, the hour and medium of the first release, the order of music videos across an EP and the placement of peaks in set lists are planned to produce particular audience reactions and sustain anticipation.
  - Sources: 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-079** (directly stated, medium): She treats the first encounter as decisive and designs its conditions — secrecy so no prejudice forms, the sense that carries the feeling (moving image over stills), and proximity where the product's appeal grows with closeness.
  - Sources: NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-080** (directly stated, high): Timing is treated as part of the idea: a move is meaningful only at the right moment, launch dates are set by weighing the product's readiness against audience waiting and market conditions, and the best moment is when an unmet need is most felt.
  - Sources: BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; 아주경제 / NNA, 2026-07, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-151** (directly stated, medium): She plans sequences backwards from the culminating event and designs where the peaks fall, for example preparing an album because a planned tour needs a secured setlist, and placing climaxes in set lists and cue sheets.
  - Sources: KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context

## P22 Curiosity over pitch; the teaser is a tool, not a ritual

- **MHJ-CL-076** (strongly demonstrated, high): She uses withholding as an engagement mechanic: what cannot yet be shown (unrevealed members, an unexplained identity, hidden clues) becomes a puzzle whose solving requires the audience to consume and share the work.
  - Sources: Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; 연합뉴스, 2018-07; GQ Korea, 2015-09; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07 …
- **MHJ-CL-078** (reasonable inference, high): Across eras the teaser is treated as a tool chosen for the situation rather than a ritual: a dense metaphor-building teaser run (f(x), 2014), no teasers when attention was already high (NewJeans, 2022), and a timed multi-video 'exhibition' when launching a label with no artist to show yet (ooak, 2026).
  - Sources: 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; 뉴시스, 2026-02, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2026-02, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-082** (directly stated, high): She markets by provoking curiosity rather than by selling: no pitch, no advertising where word of mouth can carry it, and campaigns that keep the public searching for answers instead of one-way promotion.
  - Sources: YouTube (ANN news channel; not confirmed, 2024-10, dispute context; 이데일리, 2013-12; 스타뉴스, 2026-02, dispute context; YTN, 2024-01; Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context

## P23 Give the audience something to do

- **MHJ-CL-101** (strongly demonstrated, high): She gives the audience something to do rather than only something to watch: deduction games, customisable objects, choreography made easy enough to copy, and performances left open for members to vary each stage.
  - Sources: 연합뉴스, 2018-07; Real Sound, 2023-08; 엑스포츠뉴스 (via Daum), 2023-07; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 스타뉴스, 2026-02, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-090** (directly stated, high): She treats a pleasurable surprise as a deliverable even in obligatory formats — a corporate briefing, an office, a stadium set list, a label launch — and frames her goal for waiting audiences as exceeding what they imagine.
  - Sources: BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; W Korea, 2021-04; デバク (daebak.tokyo), 2024-07, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2026-02, dispute context; Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-097** (directly stated, high): She presents the real stage of an act's development and asks audiences to enjoy the gradation of growth, rejecting the demand for finished perfection from debut and treating each release as a report on where the artists now are.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 오마이뉴스, 2013-03; 스타뉴스, 2026-02, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context

## P24 Brief the reason behind the impression, not the look

- **MHJ-CL-112** (directly stated, high): When directing a specialist chosen for an outside view, she briefs purpose, context, long-term direction and the reason behind an impression rather than a specified look, sometimes offering one optional sensory image, and then hands over the scenario and method.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 멜론 매거진 (Melon), 2023-01; 씨네21, 2023-01; GQ Korea, 2015-09; OSEN, 2013-09; 스타뉴스, 2024-09, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-049** (directly stated, high): When transmitting an impression to an executing specialist she conveys the reason behind it, at most one optional image, and the conditions for the work, not a look-and-feel; she withholds reference images where copying is the risk.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 멜론 매거진 (Melon), 2023-01; GQ Korea, 2015-09; MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; 월간 디자인 (Design+) 417호, 2013-03
- **MHJ-CL-105** (strongly demonstrated, high): She briefs collaborators with the intended relationship or feeling and a few anchors — one optional image, the core items of a look, a constraint to drop — then delegates execution, adjusting involvement to the collaborator.
  - Sources: 멜론 매거진 (Melon), 2023-01; 씨네21, 2023-01; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; 엑스포츠뉴스 (via Daum), 2023-07
- **MHJ-CL-044** (directly stated, high): She briefs styling by explaining the target concept and naming the few anchor items that carry it, then iterates with the stylists who own execution; fit to the concept and to each member comes first and cost second.
  - Sources: omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; 디스패치, 2012-08; 오마이뉴스, 2013-03; 쿠키뉴스, 2014-08; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02

## P25 Protect each specialist's strength; correct only what they missed

- **MHJ-CL-113** (directly stated, high): She treats protecting each specialist's own strength as the first rule of directing: she keeps their individuality, trims excess and corrects only the points they missed, on the reasoning that imposing her own style on everyone would make every output the same.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 스타뉴스, 2024-09, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-114** (directly stated, high): She gives different direction to each director and each performer according to their style and character, holding that leadership has no fixed answer and that the level of detailed involvement should be adjusted to the person and situation.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; GQ Korea, 2022-12; 씨네21, 2023-01
- **MHJ-CL-115** (directly stated, medium): At a scale where she cannot direct every shot, she transmits the overall context and intent, checks that it is understood, and entrusts the crew; she singles out the 'directors of directors' between her and the technicians as decisive.
  - Sources: MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-116** (directly stated, high): She treats ambition as something production erodes, so she tells specialists not to lower theirs and, as producer, accepts their risky or unrequested choices when the choice serves the whole release.
  - Sources: GQ Korea, 2015-09; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 멜론 매거진 (Melon), 2023-01; 멜론 매거진 (Melon), 2023-08
- **MHJ-CL-043** (reasonable inference, high): She judges collaborator-offered alternatives against the record's direction rather than her first preference, and accepts a specialist's risky choice when it serves the whole release.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 멜론 매거진 (Melon), 2023-08; SPOTV NEWS, 2023-09; 오마이뉴스, 2013-03

## P26 Cast for sensibility and shared cause, not status

- **MHJ-CL-048** (directly stated, high): She casts photographers and directors for the specific sensibility a project needs rather than for status - underground photographers, assistants, newcomers, a director who had never made a video in the genre - then explains intent and purpose and frees the method.
  - Sources: OSEN, 2013-09; 한국일보, 2013-02; 마이데일리, 2013-02; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 멜론 매거진 (Melon), 2023-01; Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context …
- **MHJ-CL-117** (directly stated, high): She forms her core crew around shared taste, professional attitude and a shared cause, starting each partnership by checking whether the other's path and reason for the work match hers, so that the crew can later work with little explanation.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context …
- **MHJ-CL-156** (directly stated, high): She casts for alignment of mood and values and for budding potential rather than finished qualities, and composes a group of distinct, non-overlapping individuals designed as one whole so as to avoid needless internal competition.
  - Sources: NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; 뉴시스, 2024-02; 파이낸셜뉴스, 2025-11, dispute context; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context

## P27 Produce the conditions, not the depiction

- **MHJ-CL-025** (directly stated, high): She holds that naturalness cannot be a concept - staging it makes it artificial - so it has to be produced by removing artificial conditions (performed expressions, over-set scenes, unfit rules) and building an environment where subjects can be as they are.
  - Sources: NHK MUSIC (YouTube); full interview from, 2024-02; GQ Korea, 2022-12; 뉴시스, 2024-02; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; W Korea, 2014-08; 뉴시스, 2024-09, dispute context …
- **MHJ-CL-119** (directly stated, high): Before giving staff, collaborators or performers detailed concepts, she explains the ultimate purpose and why the work matters, and she holds that explaining why each task is done removes most frustration.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; GQ Korea, 2022-12; W Korea, 2014-08; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-05, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-154** (directly stated, high): She builds room for improvisation into performance and production, arguing that trained precision lacks the feeling of improvising: she asks for freestyle rather than drilled choreography, leaves endings for performers to vary, and keeps on-set accidents that make the result specific.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; Real Sound, 2023-08; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; 오마이뉴스, 2013-03; 엑스포츠뉴스 (via Daum), 2023-07
- **MHJ-CL-051** (directly stated, high): She plans for and keeps the unplanned moment: on-set improvisation and accidents that deliver the intended feeling better than the plan are captured and kept, and she names the lack of improvisation as a weakness of over-trained production.
  - Sources: 오마이뉴스, 2013-03; 아이즈 (ize), 2014-07; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context

## P28 Clear, sparing feedback

- **MHJ-CL-106** (directly stated, medium): She keeps evaluative language calibrated at work: she does not call weak work good, praises sparingly so that 'good' carries information, and states the right direction clearly and quickly.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 경북도민일보 (News1 syndication), 2023-01; 엑스포츠뉴스 (via Daum), 2023-07
- **MHJ-CL-149** (directly stated, medium): She describes her decision style as choosing the least-regret option at each moment and making work decisions clear and fast so as not to confuse others, while keeping the end goal in view to avoid short-term losses.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context

## P29 Constraint is the engine; think instead of spend

- **MHJ-CL-131** (directly stated, high): She treats budget and deadline as the frame that produces commercial work rather than a compromise of it: fine art competes with infinity, whereas a fixed budget and time set the game, and she aims to use a given situation to the full, holding that budget is not proportional to result.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context; GQ Korea, 2015-09; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-132** (directly stated, high): She practises cost discipline by substituting thinking for spending: low-budget pilots that set a standard, video and album budgets she describes as below average, several pieces shot per trip, and inexpensive materials chosen not to look cheap; fit to the concept still outranks price.
  - Sources: 마이데일리, 2016-11; 이데일리, 2013-12; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context; YouTube (ANN news channel; not confirmed, 2024-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-110** (directly stated, high): She substitutes thinking for spending: video budgets kept below average by reusing a shoot for intimate b-side footage, cheap materials chosen so they do not look cheap, and basic elements (light, sound) applied well on low budgets.
  - Sources: KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09
- **MHJ-CL-150** (directly stated, high): She measures each project by whether it was her best within the time given, and holds that accurate understanding and concentration inside that time matter more than adding people.
  - Sources: omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context

## P30 Art and capital together (her stated stance)

- **MHJ-CL-134** (directly stated, high): She holds that commercial creative work and capital are inseparable: creative output that cannot earn loses vitality and attention, so making the work pay is what lets intangible aesthetics be noticed, and she frames joining art and business as a deliberate goal.
  - Sources: BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; Hyundai Card YouTube, 2024-10, dispute context; 스타뉴스, 2024-09, dispute context; YouTube (ANN news channel; not confirmed, 2024-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-135** (directly stated, high): She states that money follows good work rather than leading it: she starts from what she herself would want as a customer, refuses to sell what she would not want, and answers the discomfort of earning from fans with a density of quality so that no purchase feels wasted.
  - Sources: 엑스포츠뉴스, 2025-12, dispute context; MEDIAMIXI (mediamixi.jp), 2026-09, dispute context; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-085** (directly stated, high): She wins partners with the excitement of the project and a self-evidently convincing proposal rather than with a revenue pitch, and counter-proposes when a partner's brief only showcases a feature.
  - Sources: Hypebeast Korea, 2023-09; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; Casa BRUTUS, 2026-09, dispute context; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context; YouTube, 2026-09, dispute context; YouTube (ANN news channel; not confirmed, 2024-10, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-124** (directly stated, high): She argues that in commercial creative work creation and management must mesh, because work that cannot be converted into capital loses vitality and because she could only make decisions such as a three-title debut while holding both producer and CEO roles.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; 뉴시스, 2024-02; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 중앙일보, 2024-09, dispute context …

## P31 Fit the structure to the people; seek authority where outcomes are capped

- **MHJ-CL-125** (directly stated, high): She explicitly qualifies her own integration thesis: combining management and producing in one role is not universally better, since some people flourish when the two are separated and complement each other, so structure should be fitted to how each person's potential is released.
  - Sources: 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; W Korea, 2021-04
- **MHJ-CL-158** (directly stated, high): Across each move she gives the same reason: areas of production interlock, so when a downstream result was capped by upstream decisions (music, casting, training, management) she sought authority over that upstream part.
  - Sources: W Korea, 2021-04; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; Korea JoongAng Daily, 2022-08; MoTV YouTube (@MoTVshow), 2026-06, dispute context; YouTube (ANN news channel; not confirmed, 2024-10, dispute context …
- **MHJ-CL-126** (directly stated, high): She placed herself inside organisations rather than freelancing because an in-house director can set direction across everything and knows the company's reality, and when the whole process could not be reached from her position she sought a new container (a separate label) rather than a larger title in the old one.
  - Sources: 마이데일리, 2016-11; 스타뉴스, 2024-09, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; SBS 바로 이 뉴스 (YouTube), 2024-04, dispute context
- **MHJ-CL-124** (directly stated, high): She argues that in commercial creative work creation and management must mesh, because work that cannot be converted into capital loses vitality and because she could only make decisions such as a three-title debut while holding both producer and CEO roles.
  - Sources: 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; 뉴시스, 2024-02; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 중앙일보, 2024-09, dispute context …

## P32 Prove with results; pair boldness with insurance

- **MHJ-CL-120** (directly stated, high): When argument cannot overcome organisational inertia she proves the point with a result, and she treats a successful precedent as the way a new practice becomes a system and earns the right to dismantle an old one.
  - Sources: W Korea, 2021-04; GQ Korea, 2015-09; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; 김영대의 School of Music (YouTube), 2024-10, dispute context; 한겨레, 2024-04, dispute context …
- **MHJ-CL-148** (directly stated, high): She pairs bold moves with responsibility and insurance: persuading the people who must do new work, preparing alternatives in case it fails, and, when the main channel is blocked, taking a 'second-best' route such as a small low-cost project that proves the standard without harming anyone.
  - Sources: tvN 유 퀴즈 온 더 블럭 Ep.133 (official YouTube, 2021-12; 마이데일리, 2016-11; GQ Korea, 2015-09
- **MHJ-CL-122** (directly stated, high): She treats changing a large organisation from within as slow, persistent work: waiting for the right moment, accumulating small changes, and accepting that a hard-won result is soon taken for granted once it becomes the new system.
  - Sources: OSEN, 2013-09; omonatheydidnt (LiveJournal community), 2013-09; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-04; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; GQ Korea, 2015-09

## P33 Differentiated portfolio over clones of a winner

- **MHJ-CL-145** (directly stated, high): She argues that a cultural market grows through a portfolio of differentiated entities rather than clones of a winner, that a scene stays viable only if styles keep alternating, and that diversity needs both producers willing to try and audiences able to accept change.
  - Sources: GQ Korea, 2015-09; BE(ATTITUDE) (web magazine, Artist Proje, 2022-03; 뉴시스, 2024-02; KBS News (YouTube), 2024-05, dispute context; W Korea, 2014-08
